component.name: WallForge
component.summary: Modern Pixel Wallpaper Engine & Multi-Source Desktop Background Manager

description.p: WallForge is a fast, responsive, and privacy-focused desktop wallpaper engine. Featuring a distinctive Modern Pixel aesthetic with subtle retro-future touches, it aggregates wallpapers from multiple high-quality providers without telemetry or bloat.

ul.li: Multi-source aggregation: ArchImg, Wallhaven, Bing Daily, NASA APOD, Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, GitHub curated walls, and user collections.
Instant previews: Progressive loading showing fast local thumbnails before full HD resolution.
Comprehensive search: Unified search across multiple providers simultaneously with instant filtering.
Cross-platform desktop integration: Native wallpaper setting backends for Linux (Hyprland, GNOME, KDE, Sway, XFCE, MATE, Cinnamon), Windows 10/11, and macOS.
Graceful degradation: Browse, search, preview, download, and favorite wallpapers even when native wallpaper changing is restricted.
Automatic rotation: Background periodic wallpaper cycling with offline fallback support.
Customizable pixel themes: Dark, Light, Midnight, and Pixel Green themes with personalized accents.

description.p: Initial stable multi-platform release of WallForge.
